items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: And the rhythm section was me on, I was playing banjo and guitar in those days, on banjo and guitar. Alfred William on drum, Simon Moreira on bass and Alec Grutter on piano.

ctx.x: He had, they had him so long on that number, Josephine. They were still popping on that number, and he had played that famous saxophone solo on that, see. And in his rhythm section, who was on drums? I know John Moray was still on banjo, and I think Simon was living here, I think Simon was playing bass with him. And who do you have on drums?
Was this after Chani or before?
